parts.text: I'm turning 30 this year. Using the bigquery-public-data.usa_names.usa_1910_2013 table, how many babies were named Mary in my birth year?

{"summary": "Turning 30 this year means you were born in 1996. In 1996, 6,937 babies were named Mary in the US.", "sql_executed": "SELECT SUM(number) AS total FROM `bigquery-public-data.usa_names.usa_1910_2013` WHERE name = 'Mary' AND year = 1996 LIMIT 1000"}

args.query: SELECT SUM(number) AS total FROM `bigquery-public-data.usa_names.usa_1910_2013` WHERE name = 'Mary' AND year = 1996 LIMIT 1000
